entities.summary: Carey Price is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender under contract with the San Jose Sharks of the National Hockey League (NHL). Considered one of the best goaltenders in the world during his career, Price is the goaltender with the most wins in Canadiens franchise history as of the 2024–25 season, with 361 career wins.
